component.name: Videos
component.summary: Modular media player for the Aelum desktop

description.p: Plays video and audio through libmpv behind a minimal interface: the controls float over the video and fade when the pointer goes idle, files can be dropped on the window, and the player reopens where you left off.

ul.li: The launcher's short description (GenericName and Comment) is now translated into all 28 supported languages.
Fast volume scrolling registers every notch; rapid steps are no longer dropped.
The volume keeps values above 100 instead of the playbar slider pulling it back down.
